chunks: And ʿAlī عليه السلام saw a mosque in Kūfah that had been elevated or adorned, and he said: “It is as though it were a church. Indeed, mosques are not to be exalted; they are to be built plain.”

key_terms.بِالْكُوفَةِ: in Kūfah, the location of the mosque mentioned
key_terms.مَسْجِدًا: a mosque, a place of worship

ai.seo_question: Should mosques be decorated and elevated, or kept simple according to Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام?
ai.summary: Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام disapproved of elevating or adorning mosques in a manner resembling churches. The hadith indicates that mosques should be kept simple and free from ostentation, reflecting humility in places of worship.
